tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
📓 Codex: Gilberto taught Aria Gossip Network.
📓 Codex: Gilberto taught Kevin Gossip Network.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
✦ Gilberto has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Felix.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Tariq speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Sanne of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1400 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
